transcript.text: Good morning, everyone. Before we finalize this spring internship placement, I want to make sure we've addressed all the required documentation. Looking at the draft plan, I have several concerns. First, the plan doesn't specify whether the placement at Site A is paid or unpaid. Second, I don't see confirmation that the site supervisor has completed the required internship-supervision training. Third, we have no documented confirmation of transportation arrangements, health-safety needs, or student support requirements — all of which district policy requires before I can approve a plan. I'd also like to discuss whether sending the student without a job coach during the first week is appropriate. Can anyone speak to these gaps?
